content:
Overview

Santarém is a city in Alentejo with a population of 30,000. A historic city overlooking the Tagus River, known as the Gothic capital of Portugal with its many medieval churches. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
